resources.string: Quiet Ops or Vault Neon intensity, neon accent, and panic mute. Profile overlays can override these without writing host HOME in Portable Data.
Forces Quiet Ops and hides neon tech borders and gauges. Visual only — does not change the firewall or kill-switch. Hotkey: Super+Shift+P.
Each named profile may keep its own desktop.properties overlay for theme intensity, accent, icons and cursor. Switching reloads appearance from the profile overlay, then global vault props.
